description: This header file defines functions and constants related to radio operating standards management in a wireless communication system. It includes function declarations for updating and checking radio standards, as well as a callback handler for parameter changes.

methods.name: wld_rad_update_operating_standard
methods.description: Updates the operating standard of a radio device based on the provided radio context and transaction object.

methods.name: wld_rad_getEnabledRadStd
methods.description: Returns a bitmask of enabled radio standards for a given radio device based on supported standards and user selection.

methods.name: wld_rad_checkEnabledRadStd
methods.description: Checks whether a specific radio standard is enabled in the user's operating standards selection.

methods.name: wld_rad_handleOperStdsAndFormatNewValues
methods.description: Callback function invoked when parameters related to operating standards and format are changed; updates the radio's configuration accordingly.
